tldr: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 pricing sharply on Jul 30 — Terra down 20%, Luna down 80% — crediting the smaller Sol model's role in the efficiency gain. A same-week roundup pinned the driver as recursive self-optimization: the cost of GPT-5.4-level intelligence fell 13x in four months.
whats_new: OpenAI shipped an improved GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT on Aug 6 and expanded GPT-5.6 Luna to free users with unlimited everyday chats.
why_it_matters: The per-token cost of GPT-5.4-class intelligence dropped 13x in four months and Luna is now free with no chat cap — re-check your model-tier cost assumptions and whether a cheaper tier now clears your quality bar before you keep paying for a higher one.

status.state: Price cuts followed by free-tier expansion
status.detail: A Jul 30 price cut (Terra -20%, Luna -80%) attributed to distillation-driven efficiency gains was followed a week later by a Sol quality update and unlimited free access to Luna.

beats.headline: OpenAI slashes GPT-5.6 pricing — Luna down 80%
beats.summary: Terra gets a 20% price cut and Luna an 80% cut, with OpenAI crediting GPT-5.6 Sol's efficiency gains for enabling the drop.

beats.headline: Recursive self-optimization cuts GPT-5.4-level intelligence cost 13x in four months
beats.summary: A Latent Space AINews roundup frames the price cut as distillation-driven: the cost of matching GPT-5.4 intelligence fell 13x over four months.

beats.headline: Sol gets a quality update, Luna opens up to free users with unlimited chats
beats.summary: OpenAI improves GPT-5.6 Sol's accuracy and consistency in ChatGPT and expands GPT-5.6 Luna access to free users with unlimited everyday chats — turning the price cut into a free-tier capability expansion.

open_questions: Does the 13x cost drop in four months continue at the same pace, or was this a one-time distillation gain from Sol?
Does unlimited free access to Luna hold up under load, or does OpenAI reintroduce rate limits once usage grows?
take_for_builders: If your workload runs on GPT-5.6 Terra or Luna, re-run your cost model now — Luna's 80% cut plus unlimited free-tier access may let you downgrade a paid tier without a quality hit; verify against your own eval before switching.
